context:
Part A - Add missing params and fix bugs:

1. Add these parameters to generate_cli_command() signature, _VALUE_PARAMS list,
   and rendering logic:
   - platform_options: dict[str, str] | None - render as repeated --platform-option KEY=VALUE
   - plan_config: str | None - render as --plan-config VALUE
   - presort: str | None - render as --presort VALUE
   - sorted_ingestion_mode: str | None - render as --sorted-ingestion-mode VALUE (skip "off")
   - sorted_ingestion_method: str | None - render as --sorted-ingestion-method VALUE
   - databricks_clustering_strategy: str | None - render as --databricks-clustering-strategy VALUE
   - liquid_clustering_columns: str | None - render as --liquid-clustering-columns VALUE
   - global_cache: bool - render as --global-cache flag

2. Thread these through display_interactive_preview() signature and body, adding
   them to both the preview table and the generate_cli_command() call.

3. Thread them through the production call site in run.py:2399.

4. Fix compression rendering: currently `compression_str if compression_str != "zstd" else None`
   drops explicit --compression zstd. Instead, only skip when compression was NOT
   explicitly set by the user. The caller (display_interactive_preview) should pass
   compression=None when compress_data is False, and pass the full compression string
   otherwise (never skip based on value).

5. Fix table_format rendering: when table_format_compression is set and differs from
   the default ("snappy"), render as --table-format FORMAT:COMPRESSION (e.g.,
   --table-format delta:zstd). This matches the CLI's accepted input format.

Part B - Add completeness test:

6. Create a test that introspects the Click run command's parameter list, identifies
   all behavior-affecting params (exclude --dry-run, --verbose, --quiet,
   --non-interactive, --no-monitoring, --no-progress, --ignore-memory-warnings,
   --output), and asserts that generate_cli_command() accepts a corresponding kwarg
   for each one. This test breaks whenever a new CLI param is added without updating
   generate_cli_command().

The introspection test uses click.testing or direct inspection of the command's
params attribute. The set of "cosmetic-only" params is maintained as a frozenset
in the test - any new param not in the frozenset and not in generate_cli_command
will cause a test failure with a clear message.
description:
generate_cli_command() in benchbox/cli/dryrun.py reconstructs a CLI command string
from individual parameters. It is used by:
1. display_interactive_preview() - "Equivalent CLI command:" shown before wizard execution
2. DryRunDisplay - schema/query preview output

The function is structurally unsound: the parameter list is manually maintained and
has fallen out of sync with the Click run command. An adversarial review identified:

- 7 behavior-affecting CLI params not represented at all (--platform-option,
  --plan-config, --presort, --sorted-ingestion-mode, --sorted-ingestion-method,
  --databricks-clustering-strategy, --liquid-clustering-columns, --global-cache)
- 1 lossy rendering bug (--compression zstd silently dropped because of incorrect
  default-skip logic)
- 1 incomplete rendering (--table-format doesn't include compression suffix like
  delta:zstd)
- No structural guarantee that new CLI params added in the future will be reflected
  here - the two lists (Click decorators vs generate_cli_command params) are
  completely disconnected

The fix has two parts:
A. Add all missing params and fix rendering bugs
B. Add a completeness test that introspects the Click command and asserts parity

anti_patterns.dont: reconstruct the command from BenchmarkConfig.options dict
anti_patterns.why: that dict is a grab-bag with non-CLI keys (unified_tuning_configuration, df_tuning_config, etc.)

anti_patterns.dont: skip compression based on its value
anti_patterns.instead: skip only when the user didn't set it (compress_data=False)
anti_patterns.why: the default depends on config files and env vars

anti_patterns.instead: use explicit typed parameters so IDE/linter catches omissions
anti_patterns.why: it hides missing params at call sites
